name: RapidSource
content:
RapidSource ![Rapid Source Yes icon](/api/version/1/images/UmFpZFNvdXJjZQ "Rapid Source Yes icon" =24x26) leverages competitiveness by visually indicating if a feature has an Extended Lead Time ![Rapid Source No icon (Extended Lead Time)](/api/version/1/images/RUxU "Rapid Source No" =26x23) icon. Features that do not meet the RapidSource program will be indicated in the Product Selector with an Extended Lead Time icon , see [Preferred Product Offer (PPO) icon legend](docs?collectionId=3&topicId=7110). If any selected feature has the Extended Lead Time indicator the lineup will be Engineer to Order (ETO) and not qualify for the RapidSource program. To help guide you to a RapidSource solution each device has a RapidSource question that indicates if you have selected an extended lead time feature. In addition, there is a **LIST INELIIGIBILITY FEATURES** button in the header of the selector. screen that indicates RapidSource eligibility.   **Useful web links:** Product information: [Schneider Electric Low Voltage Motor Control Center Product Information](https://www.schneider-electric.us/en/product-category/51700-motor-control-centers/?filter=business-4-low-voltage-products-and-systems "Schneider Electric LVMCC") or [Schneider Electric Model 6 Motor Control Centers](https://www.schneider-electric.us/en/work/products/explore/model6-motor-control-center/ "Schneider Electric Model 6 Motor Control Centers (New)") PPO Icon Ledgend: [Preferred Product Offer (PPO)](docs?collectionId=3&topicId=7110)   ## RapidSource Eligibility RapidSource Eligibility, located on the General Requirements screen, indicates if the lineup qualifies for the RapidSource program. | ANSWERS | NOTES | | --- | --- | | Determined Upon Save | Default answer for newly created line items.
Will update when returning from Device Placement and/or Saving. | | ![Rapid Soure Yes icon](/api/version/1/images/UmFpZFNvdXJjZQ "Rapid Soure Yes icon" =24x26) | Indicates that all features in the lineup are RapidSource. | | ![Rapid Source No - Extended Lead Time](/api/version/1/images/RUxU "Rapid Source No" =26x23) | Indicates that one or more features in the lineup are Extended Lead Time (ETO).
In some cases the configuration programs will force Extended Lead Time based on Device/Auto Placement requirements. | ***\*** Saving without going to Device Placement may require clicking on the Incoming or other device to update this question.* ### Other methods to determine RapidSource Eligibility **Device Placement** Properties Panel: * Selecting Model 6 (top node) in the Lineup Tree will display the RapidSource Eligiblity for the lineup. * Selecting any device in the Lineup Tree or Placement panel will display if that device is RapidSource Yes, Configure To Order (CTO) or No, Engineer To Order (ETO). ```tips To view the RapidSource indication for all devices including the lineup, select the Print Graphic icon in [Device Placement](https://acespex.se.com/rpt/prodhelp.php?ndx=40714&grp=spex_pms&doc=aceweb "Deice Placement Help Documentation"). For best print view select the Wireframe View. ```   **Output Documents (Drawings/Customer BOM)** * The Customer BOM will indicate if the order is Engineer To Order (ETO) or RapidSource (CTO). * For CTO orders, elementary drawings provided for quotation will serve as approval drawings since CTO orders are fully system supported and require no changes. * For ETO orders, elementary drawings will indicate “Drawing is not complete and is for quotation purposes only" for units that have an Extended Lead Time feature(s). **Conditions Requiring Extended Lead Time Features** Will generate a warning in the Message Panel.
